topology: Dry path remains undelayed. Wet path retains native rate-specific lookahead; no PDC.
execution: Explicit portable reference; no automatic application adoption
limits: Literal disconnected demand and empty input metadata; unknown connected native silent flags excluded

liveTransport.seconds: One sampled context.currentTime must be exactly frame/sampleRate; every ordered call preserved, late events fresh-clamp on actual pull
liveTransport.coefficients: All smoothing and DSP in Rust; native metadata transports only projected Float32 authored targets/step flags, frame and sequence
liveTransport.acknowledgement: Processor acknowledges only after slots have been copied into owned Rust state; sender rejects ninth total outstanding edit before mutation, including inactive downstream branches.
